title: NOS-TLPlot Python Package: Visualization Tool for Newcastle–Ottawa Scale in Meta-Analysis
description: NOS-TLPlot is a Python package for creating publication-ready traffic-light plots and thirteen specialized visualizations for Newcastle–Ottawa Scale (NOS) risk-of-bias assessments in systematic reviews and meta-analyses. It includes domain and theme radars, item-level star heatmaps, stacked star profiles, donut charts, lollipop charts, star matrices and the NOS visualization grid, with four colour themes and export to PNG, PDF, SVG and TIFF.
